headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored his NHL-leading 43rd goal and scored the winning goal in a shootout, lifting the Colorado Avalanche to a 3-2 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Sunday in a matchup between two of the NHL’s top four teams in points.
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon scores in shootout to lift Avalanche over Wild 3-2

headlines.description: — Tommy Novak scored 17 seconds into overtime to complete a wild comeback in the Pittsburgh Penguins' 5-4 victory over the Boston Bruins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tommy Novak scores in OT to lift the Penguins past the Bruins, 5-4

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Buffalo Sabres

headlines.description: — Josh Doan opened and closed the scoring with power-play goals and the Buffalo Sabres outlasted the Tampa Bay Lightning 8-7 on Sunday night in a wild and feisty showdown for the Atlantic Division lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Doan opens and closes scoring in the Sabres' wild and feisty 8-7 victory over the Lightning

headlines.description: — Defenseman Miro Heiskanen scored 22 seconds into overtime to give the Dallas Stars a 4-3 victory over the Chicago Blackhawks on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Heiskanen scores in overtime to push the Stars past the Blackhawks, 4-3

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — John Gibson and Cam Talbot combined to make 31 saves, Dominik Shine scored his first NHL goal and the Detroit Red Wings beat the New Jersey Devils 3-0 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gibson and Talbot combine to make 31 saves in the Red Wings' 3-0 win over the Devils

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Anaheim Ducks

headlines.description: — Joel Hofer made 22 saves for his fifth shutout of the season, Jonathan Drouin scored in his Blues debut and St. Louis beat the Anaheim Ducks 4-0 on Sunday night to sweep a four-game trip.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joel Hofer makes 22 saves for 5th shutout of the season, Blues beat Ducks 4-0

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Vasily Podkolzin, Leon Draisaitl and Kasperi Kapanen scored in the third period and the Edmonton Oilers beat the Vegas Golden Knights 4-2 on Sunday night to tighten the Pacific Division race.
headlines.shortLinkText: 3rd-period surge lifts the Oilers past the Golden Knights, 4-2
